images.filename: Ramakrishna Mission Students Home Polytechnic College.jpg
images.caption: In 1932, Home started a licentiate course in Automobile Engineering. Initially it was a five year course. Later in 1949 this course of study was converted to a three year diploma course in Mechanical Engineering (DME). Now the Polytechnic offers Diploma in Computer Engineering, Diploma in Automobile Engineering and Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.

images.filename: Acharya Jagadish Chandra Bose Indian Botanic Garden - Howrah 2011-01-08 9879.JPG
images.caption: The botanical garden at Howrah, was known as ‘East India Company’s Garden’ or the ‘Company Bagan’ or ‘Calcutta Garden’ and later as the ‘Royal Botanic Garden’ which after independence was renamed as the ‘Indian Botanic Garden’ in 1950. It came under the management of the Botanical Survey of India on January 1, 1963. From June 25, 2009 it is renamed as ‘Acharya Jagadish Chandra Bose Indian Botanic Garden’.
images.alt: The botanical garden at Howrah, was known as ‘East India Company’s Garden’ or the ‘Company Bagan’ or ‘Calcutta Garden’ and later as the ‘Royal Botanic Garden’ which after independence was renamed as the ‘Indian Botanic Garden’ in 1950. It came under the management of the Botanical Survey of India on January 1, 1963. From June 25, 2009 it is renamed as ‘Acharya Jagadish Chandra Bose Indian Botanic Garden’.
